title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Abinaya visits Sudar's school to fulfil her wish and console Mahesh. Later, Sudar feels crushed when her friend refuses to have lunch with her, citing Abinaya's past in jail.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Azhagar boldly accepts the dance challenge from the troupe organiser. He impresses the villagers by dancing perfectly to different songs without missing a beat.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Gomathi's newfound wealth and constant flaunting test the family's patience. Meanwhile, Saravanan remains firm on marrying Anjali and fixes their wedding date.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila convinces Chozhan to send Cheran and Chandayatha on a movie date. While the couple enjoys their time out, Nila leads the rest of the family to cook a meal together.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Thamarai suspects Tamizhselvi has arrived when Aishwarya mimics her voice to calm Meenatchi. Abinav asks Eshwari to secretly replace the eye drops at Sethupathi's free eye camp.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
episodeTitle: Madhu Is Shaken by Arjun's Decision
description: Arjun's new job offer prompts him to quit, leaving Madhu shocked. Saranya blesses Arjun, while Karthik helps Kasthuri with the household chores.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira links CCTV footage with the missing QR payments to trace the fraudster. The footage helps identify the person who replaced the QR sticker.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 24: The Big Cash Box Dilemma
description: Asmitha and Saviniya clash over sleep, leaving Saviniya in tears. BB drops a cash box offer, leaving Kumaran contemplating his choice before the house turns into a wild jungle.
